notes: Hashes identify the exact inputs used by the frozen build. Licensed and cached raw inputs are not distributed; packaged derived inputs are committed. quoted_results pins the results/ artifacts the manuscript's generated macros are computed from -- the only reproducible evidence a reader gets, since the FRS microdata behind them cannot be redistributed. build_products lists the results/ files that `make paper-values` itself rewrites; they are deliberately NOT pinned, because a hash of a file the next build step regenerates records the previous build rather than the frozen evidence. Re-freeze with `python analysis/validate_manifest.py --refresh` and review the printed changes.

inputs.exclusions: SITC 971, 681 and 896; extraction and non-production chapters as documented in analysis/build_trade_by_sic.py
Same SITC exclusions and crosswalk as the calendar-2024 build

inputs.source: ONS Annual Business Survey, Sections A to S
inputs.vintage: latest non-suppressed division year; 2024 in the frozen workbook, beverages use 2022
inputs.exclusions: Suppressed division-years are skipped; latest available non-suppressed year is used per division

inputs.source: PolicyEngine UK single-year dataset built from Family Resources Survey 2024-25
inputs.note: The Hugging Face repo has since replaced this file (1.56.12 onward), so a bare download of frs_2024_25.h5 no longer reproduces these results. Pass revision=upstream_revision to hf_hub_download, or verify sha256 before running. The earlier retrieved_at of 2026-07-22 was the download date, not the vintage of the bytes; the sha256 identifies release 1.56.6 of 2026-06-19.

inputs.exclusions: Used only for the separately labelled accounting sensitivity

inputs.vintage: January 2018 to May 2026; United States, Canada, Japan and Australia
inputs.exclusions: HMRC two-digit aggregate rows are excluded from the HS4 event-study panel; detailed seven-digit numeric IDs are retained after restoring the leading zero

inputs.vintage: 2015-2024 Great Britain manufacturing employee totals by SIC division
inputs.exclusions: Disclosure-rounded public aggregates; 2024 employees are used for LFS composition calibration

inputs.source: Office for National Statistics via UK Data Service
inputs.exclusions: End User Licence microdata are not redistributed; analysis keeps wave-1 employees and treats negative UKDS sentinels as missing

build_products_note: results/referee_fixes.json is rewritten by `analysis/referee_fixes.py --only ...` and stamped in place by `analysis/write_referee_macros.py`; results/submission_summary.json is written by `analysis/write_submission_results.py --diagnostics`. Both run inside `make paper-values`, so both are build products of the paper, not inputs to it.
